title: Payment Protection Refund Terms on Cancellation and Termination
content:
These terms of the Payment Protection agreement state what fee is refunded when a plan ends, and whether coverage ends with the loan.

**Term 1 — Cancellation after the free look.** When the borrower cancels after the free-look period, the refund is the unearned part of the current coverage month's fee, pro rata by days remaining in that month.

**Term 2 — Termination.** When coverage terminates, the refund is the unearned part of the current coverage month's fee, pro rata by days; fees charged after a date of death are refunded in full.

**Term 3 — Closure of the loan.** Coverage ends when the loan is paid off, refinanced, settled or charged off.

## Terms by plan

| Plan | Refund when cancelled after the free look | Refund when coverage terminates | Coverage ends when the loan is paid off, refinanced, settled or charged off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | Term 1 | Term 2 | Yes |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | Term 1 | Term 2 | Yes |
| Payment Protection Complete | Term 1 | Term 2 | Yes |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | Term 1 | Term 2 | Yes |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | Term 1 | Term 2 | Yes |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | Term 1 | Term 2 | Yes |

## Reading the terms

- Both Term 1 and Term 2 refund only part of one fee, the fee of the current coverage month, and measure that part by the days of the month still to run.
- Term 2 adds a second refund that Term 1 does not have: every fee charged after a date of death comes back in full.
- Term 3 applies to every plan, so on any Payment Protection plan the closing of the protected loan ends coverage.
